'''''Curato salva''''' was an umbrella skill used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to classify [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|abilities]] related to [[Force healing/Legends|self-healing]]. Designated as one in a family of ''Control'' abilities, ''curato'' techniques were taught to [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] within the [[Jedi academy]] throughout the history of the Order.

A focus on self-healing, the ''curato'' family of Force techniques was developed by early [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] as a way to stay fit and maintain endurance, extend their lifespans by staving off decay, and to flush out any poisons or diseases within their bloodstreams. Viewed as a starting point for further study in the Force, the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]] designated the study of ''curato'' to be taught during the very first classes at Jedi academies. While the basics were expected to be mastered upon graduation from the academy, development of these skills would come over an entire life time, for a Jedi was never done learning.<ref name="TJP" />

==Users==
*[[Cade Skywalker]] used this technique to resist the [[Ixetal cilona/Legends|Ixetal cilona]] administered by [[Darth Maladi]]. Maladi later commented that the power was similar to powers used by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].
*[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]<ref name="TRG1-" />
